text: The user teaches Primary 4 maths at a school in Bishan.
The user has 3 classes with 38 scripts each to mark.
The user has been advised by their doctor to cut down to one cup of coffee a day.
The user's sister is having a hen party in Bali on 14 June.
There will be six other girls attending the hen party.
The user wants to use their last 5 days of annual leave for a staycation in August.
